data: Week-one essentials for new engineers joining Meridian's Squad Atlas — on-call, compliance, releases, data, architecture, and secrets.
Which tool does Squad Atlas use to run its on-call rotation and page the primary engineer?
Atlas runs its on-call rotation through Opsgenie; keep the app installed on your phone and test push notifications before your first shift (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
When an Atlas alert fires, how long does the primary on-call engineer have to acknowledge it before Opsgenie escalates?
Alerts route to the primary on-call with a 10-minute acknowledgement SLA; missing it escalates to the secondary, then the squad lead (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
On Squad Atlas, a failed payment settlement is classified as which incident severity?

Severity is set by impact to money movement: a failed settlement impacts money movement, so it is Sev1 — never downgrade it to Sev2 because 'only a few payments' failed (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
Because Atlas handles cardholder data directly, under which compliance regime does the squad operate?

As Meridian's highest-volume card processor, Atlas operates under PCI-DSS Level 1 — the strictest tier — and every engineer completes PCI awareness training before production access (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling).
How is card data classified in Meridian's data tiers as handled by Squad Atlas?

Card data is Tier 0 (Restricted), Meridian's highest data tier: it may never be logged, never appear in error messages, and never leave the boundary of PCI-scope services (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling).
What does Squad Atlas's release policy say about when production deploys may happen?
Deploys allowed any day during business hours
No deploys on Friday or over the weekend
Deploys only during a nightly release window

Because Atlas runs money movement, the pipeline is gated to refuse production releases Friday through Sunday; a fix that truly can't wait goes through the incident-change path with on-call lead plus Priya sign-off (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy).
How many approvals does every Atlas production change require before release?
Dual approval — two engineers, one with context on the area
Approval from the squad lead only
Three approvals including a security reviewer

Every production change needs dual approval, and one of the two approvers must have context on the area changed — a rubber-stamp from someone unfamiliar with the ledger does not count (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy).
Which mandatory check must pass before any Atlas pull request can merge?

The ledger-reconciliation contract test must be green before merge — it verifies that recorded entries match settled balances. A red result blocks merge with no exceptions and no override (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy).
What is Squad Atlas's primary datastore for the ledger?

The primary datastore is Aurora PostgreSQL, modeled as an append-only ledger — strong consistency for balance reads and the durability money movement demands (Squad Atlas — Architecture & Datastores).
How is the Atlas ledger modeled in its datastore?
Append-only — corrections are new offsetting entries, rows are never updated or deleted
Event-sourced with periodic snapshots replacing history

The ledger is append-only: rows are never updated or deleted in place, corrections are new entries that offset prior ones, so the full history is reconstructable — this is what makes reconciliation and audit possible (Squad Atlas — Architecture & Datastores).
What is the name of Squad Atlas's primary service and repository?

atlas-ledger-svc is the primary service and repo where the ledger, settlement workers, and reconciliation logic live — new hires should clone it first (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership / Architecture & Datastores).
What is the internal codename for Atlas's payment-initiation API?

Rail is the internal name for the payment-initiation endpoint on atlas-ledger-svc; 'submit it to Rail' means hand a payment instruction to the entry point that validates and records it (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership / Architecture & Datastores).
Who is Squad Atlas's squad lead and engineering manager?

Priya Nair is the squad lead and EM, and the escalation point for ownership disputes, hiring, and cross-squad commitments touching the payment path — book a week-one 1:1 with her (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership).
Where does Squad Atlas store all of its secrets?
AWS Secrets Manager, tagged per service
Vault, under a dedicated per-squad namespace 'atlas/'
Encrypted .env files committed to each repo
A shared org-wide Vault root path

All Atlas secrets live in Vault under the dedicated per-squad namespace 'atlas/'; nothing belonging to Atlas is stored outside it, and services read from 'atlas/' at runtime rather than copying secrets into code (Squad Atlas — Secrets & Access).
What customer-facing SLA does Squad Atlas publish for payment status availability?

Atlas publishes a customer-facing SLA of 99.95% monthly for payment status availability; breaching it triggers a customer-facing comms review, so the status path is treated as a first-class concern (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership).
